'''Spread barrels''' were a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] or [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] modification available for 1725 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The barrels increased the spread of the laser beam, allowing to hit several targets with one shot. Models of this barrel included [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[800 barrel]], [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries's]] [[8405 spread barrel]] and [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries's]] [[Model 70 spread barrel]].
